strategyFamily: causal funding-regime spot-perpetual carry with hysteresis
motivation: Unconditional BTC carry earned funding historically but Trial 16 showed that a fully collateralized always-on hedge can still lose when realized funding does not cover retail friction. Trial 19 prospectively tests a causal regime filter on two new derivative information sets rather than changing Trial 16 in place.

assetSelection.rule: ADA and DOGE are fixed as two longstanding, liquid non-BTC/ETH/SOL/BNB/XRP majors already represented in the project's historical crypto universe. Selection is based on pre-existing major-asset status, not on Trial 19 funding, basis, perpetual, or carry outcomes.

dataPreviouslyObservedAtFreeze.interpretation: This is a fresh derivative/carry replication, not a pristine spot-price-path test.

portfolio.position: when active, long spot and short exactly equal coin units of the matching Binance USD-M perpetual
portfolio.rebalancingWhileActive: none; coin units are fixed from entry until exit

signal.causality: At boundary t the state decision uses exactly the preceding 90 realized funding observations ending at t-1; the current boundary funding rate is excluded from the signal. A newly entered position receives no funding at its entry boundary. An already-open position receives the current boundary payment before an exit executed at that boundary.
signal.hysteresis: inactive to active only at or above 20% annualized trailing funding; active to inactive only at or below 8%, subject to a 30-day minimum state duration
signal.thresholdRationale: Thresholds are frozen from transaction-cost economics and persistence logic, not ADA/DOGE outcomes: the entry hurdle is materially above the approximately 2.8% two-leg round-trip notional friction when translated to a multi-month carry opportunity; the lower exit threshold supplies hysteresis and avoids churn.

finalHoldout.accessRule: No Trial 19 final derivative/funding row may be acquired unless the frozen development gate passes.

dataRequirements.spot: checksum-verified Binance Vision DAILY spot 8h klines
dataRequirements.perpetualExecution: checksum-verified Binance Vision MONTHLY USD-M standard 8h klines
dataRequirements.perpetualMark: checksum-verified union of MONTHLY and DAILY USD-M 8h markPriceKlines with exact overlap agreement
dataRequirements.funding: checksum-verified Binance Vision MONTHLY USD-M fundingRate archives

developmentGate.decision: Every criterion must pass before final-holdout acquisition. Failure freezes Trial 19 without final access or in-place rescue.

promotionCriteria.decision: Every criterion must pass. Passing authorizes a separate paper-baseline promotion proposal only; never real-money trading.

multipleTesting.newInformationSet: ADAUSDT and DOGEUSDT funding/perpetual/basis histories not queried for Trial 19 before freeze

antiRescueRule: After the first Trial 19 development economic output, no asset, threshold, lookback, hysteresis, minimum state duration, sizing, collateral, date, cost, source rule, entry/exit accounting, or gate may change under Trial 19.
